Service: New Vessel Registration (Boat)

Portal route: /vessel-registration
Registration type selection: "Vessel Registration" (Boat)

Step-by-step (portal):
1) Select registration type (Boat/Vessel Registration).
2) Follow instructions: enter required info, upload required documents, then click Submit.
3) Fill Vessel details:
   - Type of Ship (Fishing / Pleasure / Conventional Boats / Other Floats)
   - Classification (required; "Other" requires Classification Other)
   - Ship Name (required; max length 13; availability validated in UI)
   - Alternate Ship Name(s) (Name 1..4; each required; max length 13; availability validated)
   - Vessel Number (optional)
   - Type of Hull (required; "Other" requires Type of Hull Other)
   - Hull Number (required; max length 50; must be unique; validated in UI)
   - Hull Color (required; max length 100)
   - Berthing Place (required; "Other" requires Berthing Place Other)
   - Port of Registry (Bahrain; disabled/fixed)
   - Year of Build (required)
   - Place of Build (required; max length 100)
   - Previously Registered? (required)
     - If Yes: previous name, previous registration number, previous registration date, previous port of registry
   - Net Tonnage (optional)
   - Gross Tonnage (required)
   - Draft / Depth / Beam (optional)
   - Length O.A (required)
   - No of Crews (required)
   - No of Passengers (required)
   - Instances of impounding (optional)
   - Rights in kind occurring upon the ship (optional)
   - Printing House (required)
   - Acquisition of Ownership (required)
   - Vessel Mortgaged? (required)
     - If Yes: mortgage information (Bank Name + Mortgage Number; Bank Name Other if applicable)

4) Add Engines (at least 1; max 4).
   - For each engine: Engine No, Engines Type (required; Other requires Engines Type Other), HP.

5) Upload required documents (portal upload categories):
   - Copy Of CPR (required)
   - Builder Certificate OR Deletion Certificate (conditional on Previously Registered)
     - Previously Registered = No: Builder Certificate
     - Previously Registered = Yes: Deletion Certificate
   - Customs Declaration (conditional)
     - If Place of Build != Bahrain: Customs Declaration is required
   - Mortgage Deed (conditional)
     - If Vessel Mortgaged = Yes: Mortgage Deed is required
   - Optional/additional uploads supported:
     - Bill Of Sale
     - Other Document
     - Vessel Image

Notes:
- Submission depends on validity of the form + required attachments + unique Hull Number + ship name availability checks.

Service: New Jet Ski Registration

Portal route: /vessel-registration
Registration type selection: "Jet Ski Registration" (JetSkiRegistrationComponent)

Step-by-step (portal):
1) Select registration type "Jet Ski Registration".
2) Follow instructions: enter required info, upload required documents, then click Submit.
3) Fill Jet Ski details:
   - Jet Ski Number (optional; max length 20)
   - Type of Hull (required; "Other" requires Type of Hull Other)
   - Hull Number (required; max length 50; must be unique; availability validated in UI)
   - Hull Color (required; max length 100)
   - Berthing Place (required; "Other" requires Berthing Place Other)
   - Port of Registry (Bahrain; disabled/fixed)
   - Year of Build (required)
   - Place of Build (required)
   - Engine No (optional)
   - Engines Type (required; "Other" requires Engines Type Other)
   - HP (required)
   - Jet Ski Previously Registered? (required)
     - If Yes: previous registration number, previous registration date, previous port of registry
   - Net / Gross tonnage, Draft / Depth / Beam (optional fields as per form)
   - Length O.A (required)
   - No of Passengers (required)
   - Acquisition of Ownership (required)
   - Instances of impounding imposed on the vessel (optional)
   - Printing House (required)

4) Upload required documents (portal upload categories):
   - CPR Copy (required)
   - Builder Certificate OR Deletion Certificate (conditional on Previously Registered)
     - Previously Registered = No: Builder Certificate
     - Previously Registered = Yes: Deletion Certificate
   - Customs Declaration (conditional)
     - If Place of Build != Bahrain: Customs Declaration is required

5) Optional/additional uploads supported by the Jet Ski component:
   - Photo Of Jet Ski
   - Bill Of Sale
   - Insurance Certificate
   - Other
   - Jet Ski Image / Vessel Image

Notes:
- Submission depends on validity of the Jet Ski form + required attachments + unique Hull Number.

Service: New Dhow Registration

Portal route: /vessel-registration
Registration type selection: "Dhow Registration" (uses VesselRegistrationPage with Dhow classification)

Step-by-step (portal):
1) Select registration type "Dhow Registration".
2) Follow instructions: enter required info, upload required documents, then click Submit.
3) Fill Dhow/Vessel details (same core fields as Vessel Registration form), including:
   - Type of Ship
   - Dhow classification behavior (classification set to Dhow by the flow)
   - Ship Name + Alternate Ship Names
   - Type of Hull + Hull Number (unique)
   - Hull Color, Berthing Place (and Berthing Place Other if needed)
   - Port of Registry (Bahrain; disabled/fixed)
   - Year of Build, Place of Build
   - Previously Registered? (and required previous details when Yes)
   - Tonnage/dimensions and crew/passenger inputs
   - Printing House, Acquisition of Ownership
   - Vessel Mortgaged? + mortgage info when mortgaged

4) Engines requirement:
   - At least 1 engine is required (max 4).

5) Upload required documents (conditional rules match the Vessel Registration form):
   - Copy Of CPR (required)
   - Builder Certificate OR Deletion Certificate
     - Previously Registered = No: Builder Certificate
     - Previously Registered = Yes: Deletion Certificate
   - Customs Declaration (if Place of Build != Bahrain)
   - Mortgage Deed (if Vessel Mortgaged = Yes)

6) Optional/additional uploads supported by the vessel form:
   - Bill Of Sale
   - Other Document
   - Vessel Image

Notes:
- Submission depends on validity of the form + required attachments + unique Hull Number + ship name availability checks.
